_comment: Generic Discord bot egg. Nothing in here is specific to one bot.
name: Discord Bot Python
author: support@epicwing.de
description: Run any Discord bot written in Python. Use a git repository or upload your own files, then choose the main file, extra packages and start arguments.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z "{{EXTRA_PACKAGES}}" ]]; then pip install -U --user {{EXTRA_PACKAGES}}; fi; if [[ -f /home/container/{{REQUIREMENTS_FILE}} ]]; then pip install -U --user -r {{REQUIREMENTS_FILE}}; fi; python /home/container/{{MAIN_FILE}} {{START_ARGS}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
apk add --no-cache git ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  URL="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
  # For private repositories, put the credentials into the HTTPS URL
  if [ -n "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME}" ]; then
    case "${GIT_ADDRESS}" in
      https://*) URL="https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}" ;;
    esac
  fi
  # Only clone if the folder is empty, so nothing gets overwritten
  if [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
    if [ -n "${BRANCH}" ]; then
      git clone --single-branch --branch "${BRANCH}" "${URL}" .
    else
      git clone "${URL}" .
    fi
  else
    echo "Directory is not empty, skipping git clone."
  fi
else
  echo "No git repository set. Upload your bot files with the file manager."
fi
echo "Installation finished."

variables.name: Main file
variables.description: The file that starts your bot.

variables.name: Requirements file
variables.description: pip requirements file that is installed on every start. Ignored if the file does not exist.

variables.name: Extra pip packages
variables.description: Optional. Space separated list of additional pip packages.

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: HTTPS or SSH URL of your bot's repository. Leave empty to upload your own files. Only used during installation.

variables.name: Git branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.name: Git username
variables.description: Only needed for private repositories over HTTPS.

variables.name: Git access token
variables.description: Only needed for private repositories over HTTPS. Use a read-only token.

variables.name: Update on start
variables.description: Run git pull before every start. Needs a git repository.

variables.name: Start arguments
variables.description: Optional arguments that are added to the start command.

variables.name: Discord token
variables.description: Optional. Passed to your bot as the environment variable DISCORD_TOKEN. You can also use a .env file instead.
